title: Lecture 8 — algebraic data types and binary trees
summary: Build tagged alternatives and recursive trees, then trace traversal, lookup and persistent insertion.
body:
Authored study companion based on the published lecture slides, checked 17 November. Work through the topic below, then attempt its self-check before opening the solution.

Model alternatives with constructors, handle missing values explicitly, and recurse over binary search trees.

Read the linked original slides for Pyking syntax and language comparisons.

Date note: the lecture table still lists Wednesday 11 November, but the newer 8 November announcement places this ordinary lecture on Tuesday 10 November, 15–17. The Tuesday date is retained here.
